name: MONSUN
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A mono synth after the Dreadbox Typhon: one WAVE knob, three modulators, three FX blocks, a storm
description: A monophonic synth in the manner of the Dreadbox Typhon: two oscillators whose wave combinations one WAVE knob fades through (up to FM), a self-oscillating 24 dB ladder low-pass, filter and amp ADSRs with FILTER TIME and AMP TIME, three modulators (LFO, envelope, random, step sequencer) with several destinations each, FX1 distortions and bit crusher, FX2 chorus / ensemble / flanger, FX3 delay, ping pong and two reverbs, a 32-step note sequencer with record, tie, probability and swing, and STORM: detuned copies and stereo width on one knob. 16 presets, MIDI clock in. Unofficial.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
